facts.title: corn fritters
ingredients: 4 scallions, both white and greens finely chopped
1/2 cup chopped herbs of your choice
About 1 cup (6 ounces) grated sharp cheddar
3/4 teaspoon kosher salt, plus more to taste
1 cup all-purpose flour, plus 2 more tablespoons if needed
Olive or a neutral oil for frying
facts.author: Deb Perelman
